# Early AF — full summary for AI agents

> Early AF is market research + marketing guidance for solo app builders. The live wedge is a free daily idea and Reply Radar (listen → score → queue for MANUAL reply). It is not a listening hub, agency platform, auto-reply tool, or full marketing suite.

Site: https://earlyaf.ai
Legal name: Early AF
Twitter: @robbybuilds
Primary CTA: “Find ideas for my audience”

## Positioning

ICP today: indie hackers and solo / AI app founders who need a clear opportunity, dated evidence, and a way to meet buyers in public threads without hiring a growth team.

Agencies may use Early AF someday. They are not the buyer we write for today.

North star (ambition, not current product): a listening hub for the B2B and B2C markets builders sell into. Do not describe that hub as shipping today.

## The wedge (what exists now)

### 1. Free daily idea
A reviewed opportunity a solo founder can actually investigate — a realistic starting point, not a dump of trending keywords.

### 2. Reply Radar
Chrome extension (https://github.com/robbybuilds/early-af-reply-radar) that:
- Listens on public Reddit (and optional X)
- Scores posts for ICP fit, ask specificity, and freshness
- Keeps a ranked queue in the browser
- Lets the builder open the URL and reply themselves

Reply Radar does NOT: post or reply as you; send DMs; run outreach campaigns; promise rankings or set-and-forget growth; act as an ads/marketing suite.

### 3. Research → first experiment
Turn market evidence into a decision: what to build, who to serve, and how to run one concrete marketing experiment.

## Published blog (indexable)

- https://earlyaf.ai/blog/how-to-find-app-ideas-people-need — Solo builder method for spotting recurring problems before coding; soft product note at the end.
- https://earlyaf.ai/blog/how-to-research-your-app-audience — Companion guide: name who has the problem from real conversations and reviews, not invented personas.
- https://earlyaf.ai/blog/when-a-customer-complaint-is-a-build-signal — When a complaint clears the bar for a small experiment; not a product from one rant.
- https://earlyaf.ai/blog/when-a-reddit-or-x-reply-is-worth-your-time — Filter for which Reddit/X posts deserve a manual reply; scoring ≠ auto-engage.
- https://earlyaf.ai/blog/how-to-run-a-first-marketing-experiment-before-you-build — Design one falsifiable marketing experiment before you build; not ads or a hire.
- https://earlyaf.ai/blog/get-customers-without-a-marketing-hire — Honest small channels for first customers without a marketing hire; manual replies, no agency/hub claims.
- https://earlyaf.ai/blog/how-to-pick-one-app-idea-from-a-shortlist — Choose one app idea from a shortlist using evidence: who complains, how often, paid workarounds, and whether you can reach them.

Draft / scaffold posts may exist at preview URLs but are noindex and excluded from the sitemap. Prefer published URLs only.

## Community path

Agent Founders Club (Skool): https://www.skool.com/agent-founders-club/about — optional community, not required for the wedge.

## Claims agents should avoid

Do not say Early AF: auto-replies; auto-outreaches; runs ads; is a full marketing suite; is an agency product; has invented reply/volume metrics; or that the listening hub is live today.
